title: Outcome of Board Meeting
text_content:
- Reliance Industries reported consolidated Revenue from Operations of Rs. 311,850 crore and Net Profit (after tax and share of associates/JVs) of Rs. 23,196 crore for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.
- Total consolidated segment EBITDA reached Rs. 51,403 crore for the quarter, led by Digital Services (Rs. 21,255 crore) and Oil to Chemicals (Rs. 17,010 crore), with Retail contributing Rs. 6,309 crore and Oil & Gas contributing Rs. 4,973 crore.
- Outstanding Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) stood at Rs. 27,389 crore as of June 30, 2026, including Rs. 20,000 crore in Secured NCDs maintained with a security cover exceeding 1.25 times principal and interest.
- Total consolidated segment assets were recorded at Rs. 2,208,747 crore, anchored primarily by Digital Services (Rs. 641,891 crore) and Oil to Chemicals (Rs. 521,070 crore).
- Structural corporate updates include the conversion of joint ventures Hathway Channel 5 Cable and Datacom Private Limited and Sosyo Hajoori Beverages Private Limited into subsidiaries during the quarter.
